findings.title: Apply the website visibility restriction to website_name
findings.body: The new `website_name` attribute is not included in `untrusted_attributes`, so it is serialized even when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` hides a TL0 user's website from anonymous visitors. The template now displays this unrestricted value, exposing the hidden hostname (and path for matching domains) and bypassing the existing profile-field restriction. Also, `include_website_name` is missing the trailing `?`, so ActiveModel::Serializer will not use it as an inclusion predicate. Add `website_name` to the restricted attributes and cover it in the anonymous TL0 serialization test.
